immutabilityAndLineage.mechanism: RevisionEngine enforces isLocked: true on RELEASED revisions. Modifying properties throws REVISION_IMMUTABLE. EngineeringPLMEngine deep-freezes released artifact snapshots.

downstreamInvalidation.mechanism: CanonicalPLMProjectionAdapter detects upstream revision changes and marks downstream dependent artifacts STALE or REQUIRES_RECALCULATION.
downstreamInvalidation.empiricalLog: [PLM] Artifact ART-P5-ASM-01@REV-A invalidated by change in ART-P5-CAD-01@REV-A (verified live)

persistenceVulnerability.actualObservedBehavior: revisions: Map<string, Revision> = new Map(); Zero storage adapters (SQLite, IndexedDB, or filesystem) are wired to RevisionEngine.
persistenceVulnerability.impact: On browser refresh or process restart, all registered engineering revisions, approval logs, and baselines evaporate from memory.

dualRevisionArchitecture.finding: Divergence between RevisionEngine (Revision string labels 'A', 'B', '01') and CADDocument (integer revision: 1, 2). Reconciled via RevisionUtils.revisionToLetter, but lacks single unified database schema.
